verdict.rationale: Apify offers its own crawling library, Crawlee, and SDK toolkits (apify-docs-4, apify-docs-2), along with base Docker images it says developers can freely use (apify-docs-30). Its SDK also supports your own or third-party proxies instead of Apify Proxy (apify-docs-34). Together these suggest scraper code can run outside the hosted service, but most of the evidence centers on the Apify cloud platform, and nothing shows a self-hostable version of the platform itself. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that Crawlee/SDK are open-source licensed, documentation on running scrapers fully self-hosted without the Apify platform, no self-hostable platform equivalent (scheduling, storage, monitoring), no independent or hands-on corroboration.
